label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) alert-TP: User input 'param' from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to 'url'. If session attribute 'partnerCallback' is null, 'url' resolves to 'param'. The sink 'response.sendRedirect(url)' executes with attacker-controlled data. The mitigation 'url.startsWith("https://")' only enforces the protocol, failing to validate the host/domain, allowing open redirects to malicious HTTPS sites (phishing).

evidence.note: User input param flows to url, sent via redirect without host validation
